[[File:ZygerrianBrothers.png|thumb|left|150px|Jorec (right), with his brother Mard]]
'''Jorec Gemen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]], who served as a [[Royal archivist]] alongside his brother [[Mard Gemen]] during the rule of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]]. When [[King/Legends|King]] [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]] came to power, Jorec and his brother were reassigned to serve Molec's son, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]]. The two brothers were unhappy with such reassignment.
